"""E05 O2 diagnosis probe 2 (read-only; no checkpoint, no generation, nothing written)."""
import ast, hashlib, json, os, sys, traceback
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
RT = '/home/student20261/workdir/GPAT_TransferBench_runtime'
out = {}
import torch
from methods.pcgan import production_io as pio
from methods.pcgan.production_runner import build_models
from methods.pcgan import bank_adapter as ba
models, _crop, runtime = build_models(pio.build_root(RT))
bc = runtime['build_closure']
out['first_build_models'] = {'ok': True, 'source_identity': bc['source_identity'], 'import_resolution': bc['import_resolution'],
                             'extensions': bc['extensions'], 'manifest_sha256': bc['manifest_sha256'],
                             'generated_files': len(bc['generated_files_sha256']), 'jit_build_invoked': bc['jit_build_invoked'],
                             'models': runtime.get('models')}
u = sys.modules['util']
uu = sys.modules.get('util.util')
txt = Path(u.__file__).read_text()
out['tensor2im'] = {'util_file': u.__file__, 'util_is_package': hasattr(u, '__path__'),
                    'tensor2im_def_in_util_init': any(isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == 'tensor2im' for n in ast.parse(txt).body),
                    'util_util_file': getattr(uu, '__file__', None),
                    'tensor2im_defined_in': getattr(u.tensor2im, '__module__', None),
                    'pinned_source_file': ba.TENSOR2IM_SOURCE}
if uu is not None:
    t2 = Path(uu.__file__).read_text()
    node = next(n for n in ast.parse(t2).body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == 'tensor2im')
    seg = ast.get_source_segment(t2, node)
    out['tensor2im']['generated_segment_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(seg.encode()).hexdigest()
    out['tensor2im']['pinned_segment_sha256'] = ba.pinned_tensor2im()[1]
fa = sys.modules['models.networks.stylegan2_op.fused_act']
out['fused_act_loads_at_import'] = 'load(' in Path(fa.__file__).read_text()
del models
torch.cuda.empty_cache()
try:
    build_models(pio.build_root(RT))
    out['second_build_models'] = {'ok': True}
except Exception as exc:
    out['second_build_models'] = {'ok': False, 'error': '%s: %s' % (type(exc).__name__, exc)}
print(json.dumps(out, sort_keys=True, default=str))
